umf.visual.question: How do the components connect?

annotations.text: Retry behavior is outside this sketch.

umf.visual.takeaway: The review preserves the source topology, makes the witnessed frame membership explicit, and retains both free-text items without assigning heading or anchoring semantics.

source.view: Common topology and copy are source-derived. Node shapes, frame titles and memberships, free-text content, straight routes, and relative left-to-right arrangement follow the synthetic native witness; those presentation choices are distinct from the historical host previews.

omissions: The common and native inputs are synthetic witnesses; they do not establish deployed system semantics or represent a private original Miro board.

Native frame membership is explicit; this review interprets it as region-group membership. Native frame item kind/identity semantics and exact bounds remain in the companion witness; shared region groups do not assert frame/group equivalence. The reviewed left-to-right layout is placement intent, not coordinate reproduction.

Both witnessed free-text items are represented as plain annotations. The syn-heading-a identifier does not assert a heading level, and no association between either annotation and a frame or node is asserted.

The historical Miro, Google Slides, and PowerPoint/LibreOffice outputs are Visual 1.0 previews of the common topology. They do not show the synthetic witness frame titles or free-text items and do not qualify these Visual 1.4 additions.
